summaryZh: Marsala实验室研究脊髓缺血、创伤及周围神经或脊髓损伤后的运动障碍和神经病理性疼痛，以及SOD1突变相关肌萎缩侧索硬化症。团队探索细胞替代与基因治疗，使用脊髓软膜下基因递送，以及猪、非人灵长类和转基因啮齿类模型。
researchQuestions: 如何通过细胞替代及脊髓递送策略改善损伤或 SOD1 相关疾病后的功能？
methods: SOD1 转基因啮齿类模型

evidence.quote: Our research in the field of spinal ischemic and traumatic injury aims at: development of cell-replacement therapies aimed at re-populating pools of inhibitory neurons lost after spinal cord ischemia characterize the behavioral-treatment effect of spinally-grafted cells on the recovery of motor function after spinal cord traumatic injury
improve spinal gene and cell delivery techniques in large animal models (pigs and non-human primates)

Our research study aims: to understand the molecular mechanism of SOD1 gene-mutation-linked ALS, to develop and characterize a new subpial route for spinal delivery of AAV9 encoding an shRNA-SOD1, and, to test the treatment potency of subpially-delivered shRNA-SOD1 in suppressing the disease onset/progression in SOD1-gene mutation transgenic rodent models of ALS (G93A, G37R)
The Marsala Lab research program focuses on characterization of patophysiology and treatment of several spinal and brain neurodegenerative disorders
Chronic peripheral nerve and spinal cord injury-induced neuropathic pain

A recently developed novel technique of spinal subpial gene delivery is being used to characterize the gene-therapy-based treatments for ALS and neuropathic pain in small and large pre-clinical animal models.
